rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The statement 内閣総辞職に当たっての内閣総理大臣談話, dated 平成二十四年十二月二十六日, says that the Noda cabinet resigned en masse that day (野田内閣は、本日、総辞職いたしました) and reviews its work since the cabinet's launch in September of the previous year.
